summary: tri-Ace's gunplay-focused RPG, originally for PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 and later remastered as 4K/HD Edition.

entries.title: Resonance of Fate
entries.definitive_edition: Resonance of Fate / End of Eternity 4K/HD Edition

emulation.notes: Native PC release is preferred; RPCS3/Xenia are unnecessary for the main run.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native 4K/HD PC release with high-resolution texture pack.

primary.version: Resonance of Fate / End of Eternity 4K/HD Edition
primary.why: The 4K/HD Edition remasters the 2010 game, and the Windows release provides the highest ceiling for resolution, texture pack use, and capture settings.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam release on PC, install the free high-resolution texture pack from the Steam DLC section, and capture at the highest stable resolution for the stream.

entries.remaster_caveats: The remaster is a fidelity upgrade rather than a remake; use the PC version for the highest capture ceiling.
